description: This Java class, TorqueCalculator, provides a static method to compute torque based on engine RPM, horsepower, and measurement units (imperial or metric). It uses constants for unit conversion factors and is part of the com.romraider.logger.car.util package.

classes.name: TorqueCalculator
classes.description: A utility class providing a static method to calculate torque from horsepower and RPM, considering measurement units.

methods.name: calculateTorque
methods.description: Calculates torque given RPM, horsepower, and units. Uses constants for unit conversion factors.
